owned_invariants: Requests are closed JSON: unknown fields, unknown colours, unknown DDC letters and duplicate ids are refused or reported as findings.
An operation is HOST_VERIFIED only if it has a body and every host check on it reproduced the expected value; a body-less operation stays UNVERIFIED_CANDIDATE.
Any failed check or bad reference makes the candidate not accepted; a duplicated id leaves neither copy typed.
respond returns exactly one of PASS, FAIL or REFUSED.
boundaries: The host recomputes; it never trusts a value the caller supplies as the result.
No workflow calls this host yet; wiring is the next slice in docs/plans/operads_redesign.md.

score.level_basis: Typed refusals on every failure path, closed vocabularies from the canon, checked arithmetic, no unwrap or direct indexing.
